dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You make it sound like you know a lot about fireworks...

dialogues.speaker: Laktionov
dialogues.text: I do! My father once spent a fortune to take me out to set off some truly incredible Liyue fireworks!

dialogues.speaker: Laktionov
dialogues.text: But later on, I kept arguing with him, and we never did anything like that together again...

dialogues.speaker: Laktionov
dialogues.text: I was a disappointment. I never got into an art school with any real future, so I suppose he had every reason to beat me up...

dialogues.speaker: Laktionov
dialogues.text: Ahem. Got a bit off topic there. Anyway, just trust me when I say the papers I sell are packed with good stuff!
